visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and a colorful headscarf smiles warmly toward the camera in a sunny outdoor setting. She is wearing a yellow halter-neck top and a white crocheted bag over her shoulder. The background features lush green palm trees and a resort structure under bright natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a Guerlain Terracotta foundation bottle resting on a white mesh texture next to black-rimmed sunglasses. The lighting is bright and high-contrast, emphasizing the glass bottle's details. (3) We see the woman in a medium close-up as she applies liquid foundation to her cheek using a black makeup sponge. She looks into the camera with a calm expression. (4) The woman uses a concealer wand to apply dots under her eyes, then taps them in with her finger. She points to her cheeks to highlight the skin texture. (5) A close-up displays an array of Guerlain powder compacts. The woman is then seen using a fluffy makeup brush to apply bronzer and blush to her cheekbones in a sweeping motion. (6) The woman applies dark red lipstick to her lips while looking into a handheld mirror. (7) Final shots show the woman posing confidently by a bright blue resort pool, smiling broadly. The video concludes with a wide scenic view of the resort's pool area surrounded by palm trees and mountains under a bright sky.
